encoding: 8-bit sRGB JPEG; linear = srgbDecode(px) * intensity; lightmaps = Cycles diffuse direct+indirect without albedo (radiance of a white surface: multiply by PI for three.js lightMap), on TEXCOORD_1, flipY false; probes = equirect radiance, image centre +X, pos in plan metres (x, y, z up); white balance of the previews already applied; whiteBalance = that matrix (scene linear, rows) for emissive colours, which the GLBs carry unbalanced; sky.image = the world alone as DISPLAYED (view transform, exposure and white balance in the pixels: use as an sRGB equirect background, same orientation as the probes), sky.color its mean above the horizon, sky.sunDir the unit vector to the sun (x, y, z up); lightmapsOff / probesOff = the same encoding, UVs, object lists and probe positions with every lamp and emissive off: sun + sky, plus indoors a cool ambient-occlusion term (radiance 0.15 x (0.9, 0.95, 1.0) on an open wall as encoded; lit rooms have about 0.9) that keeps dark rooms readable (probes: the same radiance added uniformly, so a probe-lit object matches the wall beside it); lightmaps half the size, own intensity per image (indoors at most 1.8); circuits = per lighting circuit of a room with several, the same encoding and UVs at half size holding the light of that circuit's lamps alone (no sun, sky, ambient or emissive surfaces): with some circuits lit the room shows lightmapsOff + the sum of the lit circuits, with all lit the lightmaps atlas; share = its part of the sum of the circuits' mean radiance (scales the probe light), groups = ix group ids that switch it (other switches of the room switch every circuit), emissive = untagged emissive meshes that glow with it; bytes = file sizes; firstView = what loads before level G shows
